name: Aromatic bitters
description: Concentrated bitters built on botanicals like gentian root, cassia bark, clove and other baking spices macerated in high-proof spirit. A few dashes season a drink rather than build it — Angostura is the archetype, and it is what completes an Old Fashioned or a Champagne Cocktail. Tiki recipes push further: Don's Own Grog calls for a full ounce of it.
